Primary request: Create a decisive function-led identity for Nyra Kestrel, an adult woman who is a storm-harvesting close-combat warden. Neutral A-pose in every view, arms about 25 degrees away from torso, hands relaxed and fully visible, feet flat and parallel, shared horizontal baseline, identical scale and proportions. No weapon, no scabbard.

Design thesis and load path: one single asymmetrical split IVORY CERAMIC induction yoke rises behind and wraps around the character's LEFT shoulder only. It is a thick engineered C-shaped split apparatus with two blunt rectangular ceramic collector prongs separated by a narrow gap; it is mounted to a blackened-steel back frame. It must read as industrial induction hardware, NOT horns, wings, antlers, fins, or pauldrons. From that left yoke, one exposed but mechanically protected OXIDIZED-COPPER conductor path travels diagonally across the upper back and torso through sparse blackened-steel standoffs into one compact boxy capacitor belt at the character's RIGHT hip. From the right-hip capacitor, copper bus links descend into one visibly heavier RIGHT grounding greave: broad slab geometry, much wider than the left boot, broad flat rectangular sole, low zero heel, branching oxidized-copper shunts visible along the exterior calf and sole edge. The LEFT leg has a much lighter deep-cobalt articulated gaiter and simple flat boot for mobility. Every asymmetry must visibly serve the electrical load path.

Body and identity: mature adult woman, athletic weight-bearing body, broad capable shoulders, solid waist, powerful thighs, realistic hands and feet, no pin-up anatomy. Mature lived-in face with a slightly crooked nose, faint under-eye fatigue, one small healed brow notch, calm vigilant expression. Practical short asymmetric braid ending above shoulder blade on the character's RIGHT side, with a few small matte ceramic static-dissipation beads; hair does not hide the yoke or conductor.

Clothing and protection: large readable blocks, macro hierarchy first. Deep cobalt woven underlayer, wrap-front work jacket with straight non-bust-sculpted torso; warm ivory ceramic protective slabs only where insulation is needed at left shoulder, upper sternum, forearms, and around the right-hip capacitor; restrained blackened-steel braces and fasteners; oxidized copper only for the continuous conductor/shunts. Flat grounded boots. Selective wear only at yoke rims, belt corners, right sole contact edge, and forearm work zones.
Style/medium: premium original 2D industrial-fantasy concept art, crisp hand-authored painted rendering, restrained linework, matte material response, design-sheet clarity, believable assembly.

Composition/framing: landscape sheet, four complete figures from head/yoke tip to soles with generous clear separation, nothing cropped, pale neutral warm-gray background, subtle shared baseline, no dramatic perspective, no action pose.

Color palette: warm ivory ceramic is the dominant outer material block; deep cobalt woven cloth second; oxidized copper diagonal load path third; blackened steel structural accents; only tiny desaturated pale stormglass indicators. High value separation, no dark fog.

Constraints: exact same design, face, braid, proportions, yoke geometry, conductor route, capacitor placement, and right-greave asymmetry in all four views; front/right/back/left views only; no weapon; no extra limbs; no duplicated people; no text labels; no logo; no watermark.

Avoid: generic dark-armored anime swordswoman; monochrome dark armor; soulslike plate accumulation; corset or bust sculpting; cleavage; narrow fashion waist; high heels; fetish or pin-up anatomy; decorative spikes; horns; wings; antlers; capes; skirts; long coat tails; neon glow; floating electricity; excessive pouches; tiny noisy microdetail; franchise cues; photoreal cosplay.

Weapon thesis: this is a close-combat storm-harvesting tool, not a glowing fantasy katana. The blade is a single long gently curved blackened-steel odachi, approximately 105 cm blade plus a substantial 38 cm two-hand hilt. The blade has a thick structural spine, a clearly sharpened steel edge, credible distal taper, and full tang. ONLY near the blade base / ricasso is one small desaturated pale stormglass MINERAL CAPACITOR, no longer than one human palm. Short oxidized-copper bus bars leave this caged base capacitor, pass safely through the guard, and enter the tang/hilt. No crystal anywhere else on the blade.

Guard and hilt: a broad low rectangular warm-ivory ceramic guard with rounded corners and blackened-steel core, large enough to protect both hands but not oversized. A substantial straight two-hand hilt with an oval indexable cross-section, long enough for two complete adult hands separated by a small flared insulating collar. Deep-cobalt woven insulation over a solid core; warm-ivory ceramic ferrules at guard, hand separator, and pommel; copper is recessed and never touches the gripping surfaces. The grip must communicate full tang, compression pinning, and torque resistance. Practical capped pommel, no spikes.

Scabbard: matching rigid blackened-steel-and-deep-cobalt scabbard with a widened protective housing only around the blade-base stormglass cage; ivory ceramic throat isolates the charged guard; copper bleed strip terminates in a covered grounding stud. Scabbard follows the exact blade curve and length, with believable clearance and retention, not a plain tube.

Place the complete scabbard beside them. Use the right third for one enlarged exploded-looking but still assembled grip/guard construction detail showing cage, ceramic guard, copper bus route, tang entry, hand separator, and pommel. Clear spacing; no overlaps.
Palette: warm ivory ceramic, deep cobalt woven insulation, oxidized copper, blackened steel, tiny desaturated pale stormglass only.

Constraints: one exact weapon repeated consistently; physically caged mineral capacitor only near blade base; clearly substantial two-hand hilt; front/back/profile plus complete scabbard plus grip construction; no person; no hands; no text labels; no logo; no watermark.

Avoid: generic katana; long glowing crystal channel; crystal blade; neon cyan; lightning effects; floating electricity; huge gem; blade holes; impossible unsupported inset; ultra-thick slab blade; absurdly long handle; circular tsuba; decorative spikes; skulls; soulslike ornament accumulation; franchise cues; 3D render; dark fog; clutter.
